- Nivel 1: Otro personal del PNUD/UNCDF/VNU con nombramientos permanentes (PA) y de plazo fijo (FTA)

- Nivel 2: personal del PNUD/UNCDF/VNU con nombramientos temporales (TA), personal con contratos PSA regulares y Voluntarios Expertos y Eespecialistas de las Naciones Unidas

- Nivel 3 o sin nivel indicado: todos los demás tipos de contratos del PNUD/UNCDF/VNU y de otros organismos, y demás candidatos externos

Por favor tenga en cuenta del nivel(es) indicado(s) en el título de la vacante, si lo hay, y asegúrese de que cumple con la elegibilidad para aplicar.

Antecedentes

Descripción Oficina/Unidad/Proyecto

Como parte del plan de fortalecimiento del PNUD Argentina en el 2026, orientado a contar con las capacidades necesarias para dar una respuesta eficaz a las necesidades actuales, se recomendó centralizar las acciones de comunicación, anteriormente dispersas entre las distintas áreas y proyectos de la oficina, para contar con una unidad robusta que diseñe y coordine la estrategia de comunicación del PNUD Argentina, genere los contenidos de comunicación, defina la línea de editoriales y desarrolle las herramientas de comunicación necesarias para la divulgación de los resultados de la organización y el posicionamiento estratégico tanto de los mensajes de incidencia que se consideren relevantes como de la marca PNUD en Argentina.

Bajo la orientación y supervisión del Analista de Comunicaciones del PNUD, el/la Asociado/a de Comunicación Digital apoya la formulación y la aplicación de estrategias de comunicación y promoción estrechamente vinculadas a las prioridades del programa, y contribuye a posicionar a la Oficina en el país de manera que aumente la visibilidad, el reconocimiento y la comprensión del mandato, los resultados y el valor agregado del PNUD entre sus socios estratégicos, medios de comunicación y públicos clave. El/la Asociado/a de Comunicación Digital promueve un enfoque orientado al cliente en el PNUD.

El/la Asociado/a de Comunicación Digital trabaja en estrecha colaboración con los equipos de programas, operaciones y proyectos de la oficina en el país, el personal de otros organismos de las Naciones Unidas, el personal de la región de comunicaciones y de la sede del PNUD, funcionarios gubernamentales, medios de comunicación nacionales e internacionales, donantes y la sociedad civil. El/la Asociado/a de Comunicación Digital puede supervisar al personal de apoyo de la Unidad de Comunicaciones.

El PNUD adopta un enfoque de cartera para adaptarse a las necesidades cambiantes de la organización y aprovechar los vínculos entre las intervenciones para alcanzar sus objetivos estratégicos. Por lo tanto, se espera que el personal del PNUD trabaje en diferentes unidades, funciones, equipos y proyectos, formando parte de equipos multidisciplinares, con el fin de mejorar y facilitar la colaboración horizontal.

Funciones y Responsabilidades:

El/la Asociado/a de Comunicación Digital contribuirá al fortalecimiento de la estrategia de comunicación digital de la Oficina, aportando una perspectiva estratégica orientada al posicionamiento institucional, la visibilidad y el compromiso de audiencias. Bajo la orientación general del Coordinador del Área de Comunicación, el/la Asociado/a de Comunicación Digital desempeñará sus funciones con un alto grado de autonomía en la implementación de iniciativas digitales.

a) Brindar apoyo al diseño e implementación de la estrategia de comunicación digital.

• Brindar asesoramiento técnico especializado en la formulación de estrategias de comunicación digital y redes sociales, aportando recomendaciones claves con el objetivo de optimizar el posicionamiento institucional y fortalecer la interacción con audiencias prioritarias.

• Liderar el apoyo a la implementación de la estrategia de comunicación digital y de redes sociales de la oficina, contribuyendo a su ejecución efectiva y alineación con los objetivos institucionales.

• Aumentar y cualificar la presencia del PNUD en las redes sociales o medios de comunicación, para promover y mejorar el posicionamiento de la organización, como así también obtener una comunicación más efectiva de su misión, que genere mayor compromiso con las principales audiencias.

• Gestionar y optimizar el contenido del sitio web, asegurando alineación estratégica, experiencia de usuario y cumplimiento de los lineamientos corporativos.

b) Producción de contenidos digitales:

• Desarrollar contenidos digitales alineados a la estrategia, aplicando enfoques de relato de historia (storytelling) para comunicar resultados e impulsar la visibilidad institucional.

• Monitorear y analizar el desempeño de los canales digitales, generando insights y recomendaciones para optimizar la estrategia de comunicación y el alcance de audiencias.

• Desarrollar alianzas con organizaciones estratégicas a nivel nacional e internacional para compartir contenidos digitales sobre el trabajo del PNUD.

• Monitorear las tendencias digitales en formatos, contenidos, opiniones públicas sobre temas clave para la organización que permita ajustar la estrategia digital.

c) Trabajo en equipo y brindar soporte operativo y administrativo clave

• Contribuir activamente al diseño e implementación del plan estratégico de comunicaciones, aportando una perspectiva digital y de posicionamiento.

• Apoyar la planificación y ejecución de la cobertura comunicacional de eventos y campañas, asegurando visibilidad y alineación con prioridades estratégicas.

• Diseñar y coordinar con los colegas y los aliados acciones de comunicación conjuntas sobre temas específicos, producción de materiales, etc.

• Desarrollar actividades de comunicación interna incluyendo las plataformas de gestión del conocimiento cuando fuera necesario y/o solicitado.

d) Apoyar en la gestión y difusión del conocimiento.

• Recopilar productos de conocimiento provenientes de programas y proyectos, y archivarlos adecuadamente.

• Cargar contenido en la base de datos interna y en el sitio web.

El titular desempeña otras funciones dentro de su perfil funcional que se consideren necesarias para el funcionamiento eficiente de la Oficina y la Organización.

Acuerdo Institucional

Bajo la orientación y supervisión del Analista de Comunicación del PNUD, el/la Asociado/a de Comunicación Digital actuará como socio/a clave en la implementación de las estrategias de comunicación. Será responsable de co-diseñar y ejecutar la estrategia digital, aportando su experiencia técnica para la toma de decisiones y la gestión operativa.

Esenciales

Lograr Resultados: Nivel 1: Planifica y supervisa su propio trabajo, presta atención a los detalles, entrega un trabajo de calidad antes de la fecha límite.

Pensar Innovadoramente: Nivel 1: Abierto a ideas creativas/riesgos conocidos, solucionador de problemas pragmático, realiza mejoras

Aprender Continuamente: Nivel 1: De mente abierta y curiosa, comparte conocimientos, aprende de los errores, pide retroalimentación

Adaptarse con Agilidad: Nivel 1: Se adapta al cambio, maneja constructivamente la ambigüedad/incertidumbre, es flexible

Actuar con Determinación: Nivel 1: Muestra impulso y motivación, capaz de rendir con calma frente a la adversidad, confiado

Participar y Asociarse: Nivel 1: Demuestra compasión/comprensión hacia los demás, forma relaciones positivas

Facilitar la Diversidad y la Inclusión: Nivel 1: Apreciar/respetar las diferencias, ser consciente de los prejuicios inconscientes, confrontar la discriminación

Competencias Transversales y Técnicas

- Gestión institucional - Comunicación: Comunicarse de forma clara, concisa y sin ambigüedades, tanto por escrito como verbalmente; para adaptar los mensajes y elegir los métodos de comunicación en función del público destinatario Capacidad para gestionar las comunicaciones a nivel interno y externo, a través de los medios de comunicación, las redes sociales y otros canales adecuados.

- Comunicacion - Gestión de marca y calidad: Capacidad para fortalecer el posicionamiento de la marca del PNUD y garantizar su aplicación coherente con elevados estándares de calidad.

- Comunicacion - Producción audiovisual: Capacidad para producir o supervisar la producción de materiales audiovisuales de alta calidad, garantizando estándares profesionales tanto en contenidos de video como de audio.

- Comunicación - Estrategia digital: Capacidad para diseñar y planificar el uso estratégico de recursos en canales digitales para llegar e involucrar eficazmente a públicos objetivo, contribuyendo al logro de objetivos específicos.

- Digital - Narrativa de datos y comunicación: Capacidad para construir una narrativa en torno a un conjunto de datos y sus visualizaciones asociadas, con el fin de transmitir el significado de esos datos de manera clara, impactante y convincente.

- Digital - Redes Sociales: Conocimiento de las redes sociales y capacidad para orientar estratégicamente su utilización para contribuir al logro de resultados de desarrollo

- Experiencia comprobable en elaboración de informes técnicos, estudios o productos de conocimiento aplicados.

Habilidades Deseadas adicionales a las competencias mencionadas en la sección de Competencias:

jobs.title: Project Monitoring and Evaluation Analyst (Open to Tier 1 & 2 applicants)
jobs.description:
Tiered Approach

In line with the commitment to safeguard capacity and support personnel already in the Organization, a majority of UNDP UNCDF/UNV vacancies are advertised using a tiered application process whereby:

- Tier 0 : UNDP/UNCDF/UNV IP staff holding permanent (PA) and fixed-term (FTA) appointments, whose posts will be abolished, or contracts will be terminated or not renewed during 2026.

- Tier 1 : Other UNDP/UNCDF/UNV staff holding permanent (PA) and fixed-term (FTA) appointments

- Tier 2 : UNDP/UNCDF/UNV staff holding temporary appointments (TA), personnel on regular PSA contracts, and Expert and Specialist UN Volunteers

- Tier 3 or no tier indicated : All other contract types from UNDP/UNCDF/UNV and other agencies, and other external candidates

Please make note of the Tier(s) indicated in the vacancy title, if any, and ensure that you satisfy the eligibility to apply.

Background

This ToR is specifically within the scope of the project entitled “Enhancing climate resilience in Thailand through effective water management and sustainable agriculture”, which is funded by the Green Climate Fund (GCF) in the total of USD 17.5 million for 5-year duration (Funded Activity: FP170). UNDP is an Accredited Entity accountable to the GCF for the implementation of the project. The Royal Irrigation Department (RID), under the Ministry of Agriculture and Cooperative, is the project Implementing Partner, with the King Mongkut’s University of Technology North Bangkok (KMUTNB) and Deutsche Gesellschaft fuer Internationale Zusammearbeit (GIZ) Gmbh are the two Responsible Parties.

Thailand is one of the 16 countries identified globally as being in the ‘extreme risk’ category of those most vulnerable to future climate change impacts over the next 30 years. Severe drought and flood events are likely to be experienced increasingly in the near and longer-term future as a result of the combined effects of a more vigorous hydrological cycle and enhanced surface drying. Thailand’s agricultural sector, in particular, will be impacted by changing precipitation patterns with increasingly common extreme rain events and floods, as well as more extensive drought periods, which particularly affect poor households. With climate extremes expected to increase, climate-informed water management and climate-resilient water infrastructure will be critical in order to prepare for and respond to floods and droughts, which are the key priorities in Thailand’s National Adaptation Plan 2018. Given the cost of upgrading existing water infrastructure across the country, the Royal Irrigation Department (RID) is seeking to complement its grey infrastructure with ecosystems-based adaptation measures (EbA), an integrated solution which brings together water management and agriculture.

The project addresses the core problem of climate-induced droughts and floods threatening agriculture livelihoods and infrastructure in the Yom and Nan river basin (Phitsanulok, Sukhothai and Uttaradit provinces). Specifically, it seeks to: a) support climate informed water management, planning and investment, and b) support vulnerable farmers in reducing volatility to changing climatic conditions, enhancing climate-informed and integrated planning as well as reduce disruption to smallholder farmers.

The objective will be achieved through generation of three complementary outputs:

Output 1: Enhance climate and risk informed planning in the water and agricultural sectors through improved climate information and cross sectoral coordination

Output 2: Improve water management through strengthened infrastructure complemented by EbA measures, for greater resilience to climate change impacts

Output 3: Reduce volatility of agriculture livelihoods in drought and flood prone areas through strengthened extension support and local planning, investment in on-farm adaptation measures and greater access to finance and markets.

The Project Monitoring and Evaluation Analyst will have to closely liaise with the project’s Project Management Unit (PMU) which has been established at the RID to be responsible for project management and execution of the project.

Duties and Responsibilities

Under the overall guidance of the Head of Programme and the direct supervision of the Country Technical Advisor, the Project Monitoring and Evaluation Analyst will be responsible for supporting the project’s monitoring and evaluation activities. The Analyst will work closely with the Programme Team, Programme Analyst–Results-Based Management (RBM), and Project Manager on monitoring, evaluation and knowledge management aspects of the project.

Under the direct supervision of the Country Technical Advisor (CTA) and in close collaboration with the Project Management Unit (PMU), the Project Monitoring and Evaluation Analyst is responsible for supporting the planning, coordination and implementation of the project’s monitoring and evaluation activities. The Analyst will work with UNDP, the PMU and relevant partners to track progress against the project’s results framework, support timely and accurate reporting, and promote the use of evidence and lessons learned to inform project implementation and decision-making. The position is based in Bangkok, with travel to the three target provinces as required.

Implement and participate in the design of monitoring and evaluation frameworks, systems, and tools, and as applicable, conduct project quality assurance in keeping with corporate policies.

- Monitors project progress and participates in the production of progress reports ensuring that they meet the necessary reporting requirements and standards;

- Ensures project’s M&E meets the requirements of the Government, the UNDP Country Office, and UNDP-BPPS/NCE; develop project-specific M&E tools as necessary;

- Oversees and ensures the implementation of the project’s M&E plan, including periodic appraisal of the Project’s Theory of Change and Results Framework with reference to actual and potential project progress and results;

Ensure coordination and efficient support to monitoring, reporting, evaluation and results-based management of the project.

- Oversees/develops/coordinates the implementation of the stakeholder engagement plan;

- Oversees and guides the design of surveys/ assessments commissioned for monitoring and evaluating project results;

- Facilitates and coordinates mid-term and terminal evaluations of the project, including management responses, annual reviews of the project and produces analytical reports from these annual reviews, and learning and other knowledge management products;

- Supports project site M&E and learning missions, and visits project sites as and when required to appraise project progress on the ground and validate written progress reports;

- Provide support to other aspects of project implementation, as required and in consultation with the supervisor, to contribute to the effective delivery of project results;

Facilitate knowledge building and sharing on monitoring and evaluation

- Support the identification, synthesis, documentation, and dissemination of key lessons learned and good practices derived from monitoring and evaluation activities.

Institutional Arrangement

Under the overall guidance of the Head of Programme and the direct supervision of the Country Technical Advisor, the Project Monitoring and Evaluation Analyst will be responsible for supporting the project’s monitoring and evaluation activities. The Analyst will work closely with the Programme Team, Programme Analyst–Results-Based Management (RBM), and Project Manager on monitoring, evaluation and knowledge management aspects of the project.

Competencies

Core Competencies

- Achieve Results: LEVEL 1: Plans and monitors own work, pays attention to details, delivers quality work by deadline

- Think Innovatively: LEVEL 1: Open to creative ideas/known risks, is pragmatic problem solver, makes improvements

- Learn Continuously: LEVEL 1: Open minded and curious, shares knowledge, learns from mistakes, asks for feedback

- Adapt with Agility: LEVEL 1: Adapts to change, constructively handles ambiguity/uncertainty, is flexible

- Act with Determination: LEVEL 1: Shows drive and motivation, able to deliver calmly in face of adversity, confident

- Engage and Partner: LEVEL 1: Demonstrates compassion/understanding towards others, forms positive relationships

- Enable Diversity and Inclusion: LEVEL 1: Appreciate/respect differences, aware of unconscious bias, confront discrimination

Cross-Functional & Technical Competencies

Business Management

- Monitoring & Evaluation Ability to systematically monitor results of strategies, programmes, and activities with a view to make sure that they are being implemented effectively; Ability to provide managers and key stakeholders with regular feedback and reporting on the consistency or discrepancy between planned activities and programme management and results. Ability to make independent judgment of the management and results of strategies, programmes and activities based on set criteria and benchmark, keeping in mind the needs and concerns of client, current and upcoming. Knowledge and understanding of monitoring and evaluation frameworks, concepts, methodologies, systems, processes, and tools. Ability to make an independent judgement based on set criteria and benchmarks. Ability to anticipate client's upcoming needs and concerns.

- Results-Based Management Ability to manage the implementation of strategies, programmes, and projects with a focus at improved performance and demonstrable results. Knowledge and understanding of relevant theories, concepts, methodologies, instruments, and tools

- Project Management Ability to plan, organize, prioritize and control resources, procedures and protocols to achieve specific goals

- Operations Management Ability to effectively plan, organize and oversee different parts of corporate operations, simultaneously and in an integrated way, in order to convert the organization’s assets into the best results in the most efficient way. Knowledge of relevant concepts and mechanisms

Data

- Data analysis Ability to extract, analyse and visualize data to form meaningful insights and aid effective business decision making

2030 Agenda: Planet

- Nature Climate Change Adaptation: Climate Information and Early Warning Systems (CI & EWS)

Required Skills and Experience

Education:

- Advanced university degree (Master’s degree or equivalent) in Environment Management, Monitoring and Evaluation, Development Studies, Climate Change or related field is required. OR;

- A first-level university degree (bachelor’s degree) in the areas stated above in combination with an additional two years of qualifying experience will be given due consideration in lieu of the advanced university degree.

Experience:

- Applicants with a Master’s degree (or equivalent) in a relevant field of study are not required to have professional work experience.

- Applicants with a Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent) are required to have a minimum of two (2) years of relevant professional experience in the areas of monitoring and evaluation, development, climate change or related fields.

Desirable skills:

- Good knowledge with practical experience of M&E results-based management and project cycle management, particularly with regards to M&E approach and methods;

- Proven experience in designing and conducting research and data analysis, with practical experience of quantitative and qualitative data collection and analysis;

- Programmatic experience in implementing and monitoring of environmental or social safeguards;

- High proficiency in MS Office and excellent web navigation skills;

- Demonstrated ability to work both independently and collaboratively in a team;

- Formal training in Results-Based Management (RBM)/ Project Cycle Management (PCM);

- Professional experience in a project management setting involving multi-lateral/ international funding agency;

- Experience working with the cross-government agencies, sub-national government agencies in Thailand and/or countries in the Southeast Asia region;

- Previous experience with UN project involving the application of gender mainstreaming.

- Nivel 3 o sin nivel indicado: todos los demás tipos de contratos del PNUD/UNCDF/VNU y de otros organismos, y demás candidatos externos

Antecedentes

Descripción de la oficina/unidad/proyecto

El PNUD es la principal organización de las Naciones Unidas en la lucha para poner fin a la injusticia de la pobreza, la desigualdad y el cambio climático. Trabajando con nuestra amplia red de expertos y socios en 170 países, ayudamos a las naciones a construir soluciones integradas y duraderas para las personas y el planeta.

El PNUD trabaja en más de 170 países y territorios, dando asistencia para desarrollar políticas, habilidades de liderazgo y asociación, capacidades institucionales y construcción de resiliencia, fomentando el desarrollo humano sostenible. En Panamá trabaja a nivel nacional, nivel municipal y comarcal. El PNUD hace parte de las Agencias, Fondos y Programas de las Naciones Unidas en Panamá aportando al logro del Marco de Cooperación de las Naciones Unidas para el Desarrollo Sostenible (UNSDCF en inglés).

Por más de 50 años, el Programa de las Naciones Unidas (PNUD) ha sido un aliado estratégico de Panamá, centrándose en soluciones integradas y alineadas con las prioridades nacionales, apoyando la gestión, implementación y ejecución de programas y proyectos en beneficio de las personas.

El PNUD en Panamá está organizado en tres grupos programáticos que coordinan más de 40 proyectos en todo el territorio nacional:

- Igualdad e inclusión social, económica y ambiental

- Gobernabilidad, paz y derechos humanos

- Cambio climático, gestión integral ambiental y reducción de riesgos y desastres

En el PNUD, la gestión basada en resultados, la igualdad de género, los derechos humanos, el enfoque multidimensional, el desarrollo territorial, la innovación, digitalización y el uso de nuevas tecnologías son transversales en todas nuestras áreas de trabajo y proyectos.

Dentro del Clúster de Igualdad e Inclusión Social, Económica y Ambiental, se brinda asistencia al Gobierno de Panamá en alineamiento con el Marco de Cooperación de las Naciones Unidas para el Desarrollo Sostenible en Panamá 2026-2030 y el Plan Estratégico del PNUD 2026-2030, los cuales destacan la necesidad de fortalecer el capital humano, reducir las desigualdades y apoyar la innovación y el crecimiento sostenible. Este proyecto responde a estos objetivos a través de una intervención que aborda tanto los desafíos estructurales de INADEH como la capacitación en habilidades esenciales para la empleabilidad y el desarrollo económico.

El proyecto “Latidos del Barrio: Cultura que Transforma Comunidades” es una iniciativa impulsada por el Ministerio de Cultura con apoyo del PNUD, orientada a fortalecer la inclusión social, la cohesión comunitaria, la participación ciudadana, el acceso a servicios culturales y formativos, la activación deportiva y la economía creativa en territorios priorizados. El proyecto operará mediante una Unidad Coordinadora del Proyecto, con enfoque territorial, gestión basada en resultados, articulación interinstitucional, acompañamiento comunitario y cumplimiento de los procedimientos aplicables del PNUD.

Funciones y Responsabilidades:

El/La Coordinador/a de Gestión de Programas Culturales, Deportes y Entrenamiento brindará apoyo al Ministerio de Cultura mediante la planificación, coordinación y supervisión técnica de la oferta programática cultural, deportiva, artística, recreativa y formativa del proyecto, asegurando una implementación participativa, articulada y culturalmente pertinente en los territorios priorizados.

Asimismo, promoverá la participación efectiva de las comunidades, el fortalecimiento del tejido social y la articulación con actores locales e institucionales, garantizando el cumplimiento de las normas, políticas y procedimientos del PNUD y el uso eficiente de los recursos asignados, enfocándose en las siguientes actividades:

1. Programación Cultural y Artística

- Diseñar la programación anual de talleres, actividades, festivales, muestras, exposiciones y procesos artísticos comunitarios.

- Coordinar redes de teatro, danza y movimiento, artes plásticas, música y otras expresiones culturales.

- Supervisar la calidad pedagógica y metodológica de las actividades formativas.

2. Programación deportiva y recreativa

- Coordinar actividades deportivas, recreativas y de convivencia comunitaria.

- Promover el deporte como herramienta de inclusión, disciplina, liderazgo, bienestar y cohesión social.

- Articular las actividades deportivas con los objetivos sociales y comunitarios del proyecto.

3. Articulación interinstitucional

- Coordinar con gobiernos locales, instituciones públicas, escuelas, organizaciones comunitarias, ONG y aliados territoriales.

- Facilitar la participación de actores locales en actividades culturales, deportivas, formativas y comunitarias.

- Contribuir a la sostenibilidad territorial y la apropiación social del proyecto.

4. Apoyar la creación, el intercambio y el fortalecimiento del conocimiento, así como el desarrollo de capacidades relevantes para el proyecto.

- Coordinar procesos de formación para niños, jóvenes, mujeres, líderes comunitarios y emprendedores creativos.

- Articular actividades con escuelas, instituciones formativas, organizaciones culturales y aliados especializados.

- Supervisar contenidos, metodologías, asistencia, permanencia y resultados de aprendizaje.

- Brindar apoyo en la difusión e intercambio de datos relevantes y lecciones aprendidas dentro de la oficina de país y a nivel regional. Mantenerse al tanto de las mejores prácticas emergentes a nivel nacional, regional e internacional relacionadas con el trabajo del proyecto asignado.

- Realizar contribuciones valiosas a redes de conocimiento y comunidades de práctica. Apoyar la recopilación y sistematización del conocimiento, los productos y las herramientas del proyecto, así como su amplia distribución a los socios.

- Coordinar laboratorios creativos y digitales vinculados a la programación.

- Promover iniciativas de emprendimiento cultural, producción artística y habilidades digitales.

- Identificar oportunidades de articulación con la economía creativa local.

El titular desempeña otras funciones dentro de su perfil funcional que se consideren necesarias para el funcionamiento eficiente de la Oficina y la Organización.

jobs.title: Programme Analyst -P1- [Open to internal and external applicants]
jobs.description:
Background

The European Union (EU) is one of UNDP's largest institutional partners. The two organizations are partnering to advance democratic governance, prevent and recover from conflict and natural disasters, build resilience, and support adaptation to climate change, in line with the 2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development.

UNDP's Regional Bureau for Europe and the Commonwealth of Independent States (RBEC) covers the Eastern Partnership countries and Central Asia, a region where the EU has significantly deepened its political and financial engagement in recent years, including through the Economic and Investment Plans for the Eastern Partnership and Central Asia. This creates growing scope and complexity for joint policy dialogue and programmatic cooperation between UNDP and the EU.

The UNDP Representation Office in Brussels leads and coordinates UNDP's institutional relationship with the EU.

Within the Office, the Director, Special Advisor EU Partnerships is responsible for positioning UNDP with EU institutions and Member States on issues relevant to RBEC, and for supporting the Regional Bureau, the Regional Hub and Country Offices in translating this partnership into effective programming.

To support the Office and RBEC in advancing UNDP's partnership with the EU, the Programme Analyst contributes towards both operational and strategic priorities. The incumbent provides direct support in the formulation, clearance and management of EU-funded contribution agreements, and broader substantive support to positioning UNDP with the EU on issues relevant to the RBEC region. The role is expected to allocate approximately equal time to these two areas of work, contributing to both the operational soundness and strategic depth of the EU-RBEC partnership.

Position Purpose

Under the overall guidance of the Director, Special Advisor EU Partnerships (primary) and the technical guidance and supervision of the Contract Management Unit (CMU) Team Leader (technical secondary on contractual matters), the Programme Analyst will provide combined substantive partnership and contract management support, focused on RBEC's engagement with the EU on the Eastern Partnership countries and Central Asia.

S/he will work in close coordination with the RBEC Regional Hub, Country Offices, and UNDP's Contract Management Unit (CMU).

UNDP adopts a portfolio approach to accommodate changing business needs and leverage linkages across interventions to achieve its strategic goals. Therefore, UNDP personnel are expected to work across units, functions, teams, and projects in multidisciplinary teams in order to enhance and enable horizontal collaboration.

Key Duties and Responsibilities

1. Facilitate EU Engagement, Partnership and Outreach

- Support the positioning of UNDP vis-à-vis the EU on issues relevant to the Eastern Partnership countries and Central Asia, including by drafting briefing notes, talking points, mission reports and agendas, and by supporting exchanges between UNDP and EU leadership and counterparts.

- Contribute to the organization of outreach and visibility events (workshops, launches, high-level meetings) showcasing the EU-UNDP partnership in the region, in coordination with Country Offices, the Regional Hub and the Brussels Office.

2. Engage in Strategic Analysis, Resource Mobilization and Partnership Development

- Monitor and analyse development trends in the region as well as the evolution of EU priorities, policies and programming instruments relevant to the Eastern Partnership countries and Central Asia, translating findings into actionable inputs for RBEC and the Brussels Office.

- Contribute to the resource mobilization efforts, including scanning EU funding opportunities and calls for proposals, and contributing to the drafting of concept notes and proposals.

- Maintain and manage the partnership with DG ECHO and the Service for Foreign Policy Instruments (FPI), given the time-critical and sensitive nature of these humanitarian and crisis-response programmes.

3. Provide EU Contribution Agreement Management and Programme Support

- Contribute to the formulation and review of EU-funded programme/project proposals and contribution agreements for RBEC, and support Country Offices in assessing reports and facilitating their submission in line with the applicable EU-UNDP contractual framework.

- Support the clearance, monitoring and administration of RBEC's EU contribution agreements, including tracking contractual milestones, reporting deadlines and verification requirements, in coordination with the Contract Management Unit.

4. Facilitate Knowledge Management and Coordination

- Facilitate knowledge management and coordination between Country Offices, the Regional Hub and the Brussels Office on EU contractual, programmatic and partnership matters.

The incumbent performs other duties within their functional profile as deemed necessary for the efficient functioning of the Office and the Organization

Supervisory/Managerial Responsibilities: None

Competencies

Core Competencies

- Achieve Results: LEVEL 1: Plans and monitors own work, pays attention to details, delivers quality work by deadline

- Think Innovatively: LEVEL 1: Open to creative ideas/known risks, is a pragmatic problem solver, makes improvements

- Learn Continuously: LEVEL 1: Open-minded and curious, shares knowledge, learns from mistakes, asks for feedback

- Adapt with Agility: LEVEL 1: Adapts to change, constructively handles ambiguity/uncertainty, is flexible

- Act with Determination: LEVEL 1: Shows drive and motivation, able to deliver calmly in the face of adversity, confident

- Engage and Partner: LEVEL 1: Demonstrates compassion/understanding towards others, forms positive relationships

- Enable Diversity and Inclusion: LEVEL 1: Appreciate/respect differences, aware of unconscious bias, confront discrimination

Cross-Functional & Technical Competencies

- Business Direction & Strategy — System Thinking: Ability to use objective problem analysis and judgement to understand how interrelated elements coexist within an overall process or system, and to consider how altering one element can impact on other parts of the system.

- Business Management — Communications: Communicate in a clear, concise and unambiguous manner both through written and verbal communication; to tailor messages and choose communication methods depending on the audience. Ability to manage communications internally and externally, through media, social media and other appropriate channels

- Business Management — Monitoring & Evaluation: Ability to systematically monitor results of strategies, programmes, and activities with a view to make sure that they are being implemented effectively; Ability to provide managers and key stakeholders with regular feedback and reporting on the consistency or discrepancy between planned activities and programme management and results. Ability to make independent judgment of the management and results of strategies, programmes and activities based on set criteria and benchmarks, keeping in mind the needs and concerns of clients, current and upcoming. Knowledge and understanding of monitoring and evaluation frameworks, concepts, methodologies, systems, processes, and tools. Ability to make an independent judgement based on set criteria and benchmarks. Ability to anticipate clients' upcoming needs and concerns.

- Business Development — Knowledge Facilitation: Ability to animate individuals and groups, internally and externally, and to design and facilitate activities, to share and exchange knowledge, information, and ideas. Knowledge of tools and approaches to stimulate active participation, contribution, and exchange.

- Partnership Management — Multi-stakeholder engagement and funding: Knowledge and ability to forge multi-stakeholder partnerships, and remove any obstacles to resource mobilization and multi-stakeholder funding platforms

- Partnership Management — EU Partnerships: Knowledge and understanding of EU strategies, approaches, processes and systems

- Business Management — Portfolio Management: Ability to select, prioritise and control the organization's programmes and projects in line with its strategic objectives and capacity. Ability to balance the implementation of change initiatives with regular activities for optimal return on investment. Knowledge and understanding of key principles of project, programme, and portfolio management

Required Skills and Experience

Education:

- Advanced university degree (Master's degree or equivalent) in Public Administration, Political Science, International Relations, European Studies, Economics, Law, or other related field is required.

OR

- A first-level university degree (Bachelor’s degree) in the areas mentioned above in combination with an additional two years of qualifying experience will be given due consideration in lieu of the advanced university degree.

Experience:

- Applicants with a Master’s degree (or equivalent) in a relevant field of study are not required to have professional work experience.

- Applicants with a Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent) are required to have a minimum of two (2) years of relevant professional experience in programme/project support, partnerships, contract or grant management, or advisory services at the national and/or international level.

- Experience and knowledge, and ability to engage donors, including the European Union, in support of programme priorities is required.

- Expertise in the European Union's policies, institutions, priorities, programme cycle and external funding instruments (development and humanitarian assistance) and proven ability to apply this knowledge to strengthen the EU-UNDP partnership is required.

- Experience with the EU-UNDP partnership and its contractual and reporting framework is desired

- Experience in supporting programme/project proposal development review is desired.

- Experience in organizing meetings, missions and events, and in preparing briefing notes, presentations and other communication materials is desired.

- Experience and knowledge of the RBEC region, including the Eastern Partnership countries and Central Asia, and of UNDP's programming in the region is an asset.

- Experience and knowledge of political, economic and development trends in Eastern Europe, the South Caucasus and Central Asia is an asset.

- Experience and good understanding of UNDP programming and project management arrangements is desired.

Language:

- Fluency in English is required.

- Working Knowledge of another UN language is an asset.

Equal opportunity

As an equal opportunity employer, UNDP values diversity as an expression of the multiplicity of nations and cultures where we operate and, as such, we encourage qualified applicants from all backgrounds to apply for roles in the organization. Our employment decisions are based on merit and suitability for the role, without discrimination.

UNDP is also committed to creating an inclusive workplace where all personnel are empowered to contribute to our mission, are valued, can thrive, and benefit from career opportunities that are open to all.

Sexual harassment, exploitation, and abuse of authority

UNDP does not tolerate harassment, sexual harassment, exploitation, discrimination, and abuse of authority. All selected candidates, therefore, undergo relevant checks and are expected to adhere to the respective standards and principles.

Probation

For all new UNDP fixed-term appointments (FTA), including for staff members being transferred or seconded to UNDP under the Inter-Organization Agreement concerning Transfer, Secondment or Loan of Staff, on an appointment of more than one year, continuation of the appointment beyond the initial 12 months is contingent upon the successful completion of a probationary period.

Right to select multiple candidates

UNDP reserves the right to select one or more candidates from this vacancy announcement. We may also retain applications and consider candidates applying to this post for other similar positions with UNDP at the same grade level and with similar job description, experience and educational requirements.

Background

The Office of Audit and Investigations (OAI) reports to the Administrator and is responsible for internal audit and investigations services to UNDP and its affiliated entities. OAI provides independent, objective assurance on the effectiveness of risk management and the effectiveness and adequacy of internal controls.

OAI has a decentralized organizational structure with Directorate and other headquarter units based in New York, and Regional Audit Center’s (RACs) located in five locations: Kuala Lumpur (Malaysia), Pretoria (South Africa), Dakar (Senegal), Panama City (Panama) and Istanbul (Turkey).

OAI’s audit work is conducted under the standards set by the Institute of Internal Auditors (IIA).

Duties and Responsibilities

The primary role of the incumbent will be to contribute their analytic, research, writing, communications, information technology, and other talents to special projects and tasks that further the mission of OAI. The incumbent’s portfolio may include roles on audits, advisory services, products, process improvements, and business transformation efforts.

UNDP adopts a portfolio approach to accommodate changing business needs and leverage linkages across interventions to achieve its strategic goals. Therefore, UNDP personnel are expected to work across units, functions, teams, and projects in multidisciplinary teams in order to enhance and enable horizontal collaboration.

Under the direct supervision of the Deputy Director, contribute to the development and deployment of special initiatives that further the mission of OAI.

- Contributes to the OAI reporting requirements, such as annual reports, presentations, statistics, analysis, clear writing, and use of visual storytelling.

- Contributes to the development and enhancement of OAI management dashboards, databases, and data collection instruments.

- Contributes to research, analysis, drafting and evidence-gathering in support of initiatives associated with OAI’s strategic plan.

- Facilitates and participates in communications/outreach efforts, including creating newsletters, web designs, event planning/execution, and other communications

- Contributes to the development, enhancement and refinement of OAI electronic/printed products and external website.

- Other duties as assigned.

As a contributor and team member, and under the supervision of a team leader, participates in selected OAI audit and advisory services.

- Support with the coordination, research, analysis, drafting and evidence-gathering for OAI’s audit and advisory functions.

- Prepare working papers for review by the audit team leader.

- Draft specific parts of audit reports and/or supporting analysis for review by the team leader.

Contributes to the ongoing development of professional practices within OAI and support knowledge sharing.

- Participates in knowledge sharing sessions, learning activities, etc.

- Participates in the implementation of their personal learning and training development plan.

The incumbent performs other duties within their functional profile as deemed necessary for the efficient functioning of the Office and the Organization.

This position is primarily in New York. It may require undertaking missions with other OAI staff to UNDP offices and project sites around the world.

- Tier 0 : UNDP/UNCDF/UNV IP staff holding permanent (PA) and fixed-term (FTA) appointments, whose posts will be abolished, or contracts will be terminated or not renewed during 2026.

- Tier 1 : Other UNDP/UNCDF/UNV staff holding permanent (PA) and fixed-term (FTA) appointments

- Tier 2 : UNDP/UNCDF/UNV staff holding temporary appointments (TA), personnel on regular PSA contracts, and Expert and Specialist UN Volunteers

- Tier 3 or no tier indicated : All other contract types from UNDP/UNCDF/UNV and other agencies, and other external candidates

Please make note of the Tier(s) indicated in the vacancy title, if any, and ensure that you satisfy the eligibility to apply.

Background

Moldova is part of the EU’s European Neighborhood Policy (ENP) and in the Eastern Partnership framework, which aims at strengthening individual and regional relationships between the EU and countries in its neighborhood. Moldova is also part of the Energy Community Treaty since 2010 and has signed the Association Agreement with EU in June 2014, including the DCFTA which entered into force in 2016. As a follow-up, Moldova is required to ensure transposition of the EU acquis Communautaire, which underpins the EU energy legislation on electricity, gas, oil, renewables, energy efficiency and environment. The country has synchronized its electricity network with the ENTSO-E to connect to European electricity market.

Considering the ongoing energy crisis, the energy sector is one of the top priorities for the Government and it is addressed in Government’s Plans and a number of policy documents, laws and regulations which outlined the need to undertake more actions towards a green and just energy transition of the Republic of Moldova.

In accordance to the existing strategic planning documents, one of main priorities of the Government is to diversify the energy mix with more renewable energy, which is also fully in line with commitments under the EU Clean Energy for all Europeans package. Achieving this goal will require significant investment in the medium and long term, but also the country’s ability to attract and absorb the funds. The development of renewables, such as wind and solar, will also depend on improving the balancing capabilities of the Moldovan power system and its integration with neighboring countries.

In this regard the EU and Moldova stressed the importance of resilience against any potential efforts by third parties to use energy as a geopolitical level. The EU has urged Moldova to ensure that the energy sector reform demonstrates full respect of the Energy Community acquis and is in line with the EU Third Energy Package. The EU side confirmed its support to the objective of Moldova for integration into the EU energy system and market, an important step being the recent synchronization of its electricity network with the Continental European Network (CEN).

Recognizing the importance of a just and green energy transition in addressing the root causes of the ongoing crisis, the "Accelerating a Just Energy Transition in the Republic of Moldova" portfolio of interventions has emerged - co-designed with the Government and other representatives of the energy system to ensure its relevance and effectiveness.

Through this Portfolio of interventions, the Government of Moldova will be further assisted to tackle the current energy crisis and energy poverty, and addressing prioritized systemic elements in the energy sector to cope with potential future energy crisis.

The Accelerating a Just Energy Transition in Republic of Moldova has the following five key areas of intervention:

- Accelerate Energy Diversification and Efficiency: By supporting the modernization of infrastructure, buildings, and the grid, the Project aims to increase access to renewable energy sources, promote energy efficiency, and encourage investment in renewable energy and innovative technologies.

- Decarbonizing Industries and Economic Sectors: The Project seeks to drive the decarbonization of various economic sectors such as construction, transportation, agriculture, and the private sector. It aims to promote sustainable practices, share green business models, and develop vocational skills for the green energy sector to create equitable employment opportunities and support the transition to a low-carbon economy.

- Foster Sustainable Consumption Patterns: Through comprehensive public awareness campaigns and educational materials, the Project aims to deepen understanding of energy efficiency and renewable energy among community members, business leaders, and government agencies. It strives to promote behaviour change towards sustainable energy practices, particularly among vulnerable populations.

- Strengthen Inclusive Energy Governance: The Project recognizes the importance of inclusive energy governance at both the national and local levels. It aims to strengthen the capacity of relevant institutions and stakeholders to effectively govern and manage the energy sector. By promoting transparency, accountability, and participation, the Project seeks to ensure that decision-making processes related to energy transition are inclusive, empowering all segments of society, including marginalized groups.

- Addressing Energy Vulnerability and Promoting Resilience: One of the Project 's primary focus is to address energy vulnerability and promote resilience among households and businesses. It will provide further support to the Government in improving and implementing compensation mechanisms, including the established an on-bill compensation mechanism targeting the households by level of vulnerability. This intervention aims to provide immediate relief to energy-poor households and the private sector, while also fostering long-term energy resilience and efficiency. The Project places a strong emphasis on meeting the energy needs of vulnerable groups, prioritizing affordability, reliability, and sustainability. To this end, it will explore conceptualisation of decentralized energy solutions, off-grid options, and harness the role of energy access in conflict and disaster recovery efforts, livelihoods, and social inclusion.

Implementation period: 2023-2027.

The specific duties and responsibilities of the Project Associate during the assignment will include, but not be limited to, the following:

Assist in efficient delivery of the projects, focusing on achievement of the following results:

- Undertake administrative, logistical, travel, procurement, financial and asset management tasks in full compliance with UNDP rules, regulations and policies;

Tiered Approach

In line with the commitment to safeguard capacity and support personnel already in the Organization, a majority of UNDP UNCDF/UNV vacancies are advertised using a tiered application process whereby:

- Tier 0 : UNDP/UNCDF/UNV IP staff holding permanent (PA) and fixed-term (FTA) appointments, whose posts will be abolished, or contracts will be terminated or not renewed during 2026.

- Tier 1 : Other UNDP/UNCDF/UNV staff holding permanent (PA) and fixed-term (FTA) appointments

- Tier 2 : UNDP/UNCDF/UNV staff holding temporary appointments (TA), personnel on regular PSA contracts, and Expert and Specialist UN Volunteers

- Tier 3 or no tier indicated : All other contract types from UNDP/UNCDF/UNV and other agencies, and other external candidates

Please make note of the Tier(s) indicated in the vacancy title, if any, and ensure that you satisfy the eligibility to apply.

Background

The United Nations Development Programme (UNDP) is the UN’s global development network, working in around 170 countries and territories. In Bosnia and Herzegovina, UNDP is committed to helping the country through strengthened national and local capacities to carry out political, economic and social reforms and promote development. In line with its 2026-2030 Country Programme, UNDP in Bosnia and Herzegovina (BiH) focuses on inclusive green growth, human capital development and accountable institutions and social cohesion. UNDP is fully committed to supporting BiH in achieving its Agenda 2030 commitments and advancing its European Union (EU) integration priorities. Across all areas of work, UNDP applies conflict-sensitive, integrated, and innovative approaches tailored to the country's development needs.

Accelerating Rights-Based Trade and Investment in BiH (ARTI BiH) aims to strengthen responsible business conduct in Bosnia and Herzegovina by supporting policy dialogue, institutional capacity development and practical application of human rights and environmental due diligence standards. The project responds to the growing importance of responsible business conduct for Bosnia and Herzegovina’s EU accession process, competitiveness and participation in EU-linked value chains, particularly in light of evolving EU and international sustainability requirements. The project seeks to address existing gaps in the readiness of public institutions, the private sector, financial institutions and the broader business support ecosystem to implement responsible business conduct in practice. Particular attention is placed on strengthening capacities of SMEs and relevant support institutions to understand and apply the UN Guiding Principles on Business and Human Rights (UNGPs), Human Rights Due Diligence (HRDD), environmental due diligence and related EU sustainability requirements.

The project is structured around three mutually reinforcing areas. First, it will support national policy dialogue and development of a roadmap for a National Action Plan on Business and Human Rights. Second, it will establish a Business and Human Rights Innovation Lab and strengthen cooperation with academia and Business Development Support Organizations to develop practical knowledge products, technical guidance and the functional concept for a digital HRDD/RBC self-assessment tool. Third, the project will work with the financial sector to strengthen understanding and integration of Business and Human Rights considerations into risk assessment and advisory practices. The project applies a human rights-based and gender-responsive approach, recognizing that business operations, supply-chain changes and sustainability requirements can affect women and other groups differently. Gender considerations will therefore be mainstreamed across relevant technical assistance, capacity-building, stakeholder engagement and knowledge-development activities.

To support the implementation of the project, the Business and Human Rights Analyst will provide day-to-day coordination and substantive support to the implementation of project activities, including work planning, stakeholder engagement, monitoring, reporting and knowledge management, in close cooperation with government institutions, private sector actors, academia, financial institutions, business support organizations and other relevant partners.

Duties and Responsibilities

Under the direct supervision of the Sustainable Growth Sector Leader, the Business and Human Rights Analyst will be responsible for the following functions:

a) Contribute to coordination and implementation of project activities

- Contribute to the day-to-day coordination and implementation of project activities in accordance with the approved work plan and agreed timelines;

- Contribute to the preparation and regular updating of project work plans, activity schedules and implementation arrangements;

- Coordinate with relevant government institutions, private sector actors, academia, Business Development Support Organizations, financial institutions, civil society and development partners to facilitate timely implementation of project activities;

- Support the organization and coordination of meetings, consultations, policy dialogues, workshops, trainings and other project events;

- Monitor progress of project activities and follow up on agreed actions, timelines and deliverables;

- Contribute to the preparation of project progress updates, reports, briefing notes, presentations and other implementation-related documentation.

b) Substantive and technical support on Business and Human Rights and responsible business conduct

- Provide substantive and technical support to activities promoting responsible business conduct, the UN Guiding Principles on Business and Human Rights and Human Rights Due Diligence;

- Contribute to the organization and implementation of multi-stakeholder policy dialogue related to Business and Human Rights and development of the roadmap for a National Action Plan;

- Prepare and review analytical inputs, guidance materials, knowledge products and other technical documentation related to Business and Human Rights, HRDD and relevant EU and international sustainability requirements;

- Contribute to the cooperation with academia and Business Development Support Organizations in the development and dissemination of practical tools, guidance and capacity-building materials;

- Contribute to the development of the functional and operational concept for the planned digital HRDD/RBC self-assessment tool, including coordination of relevant stakeholder inputs.

c) Engagement with the private and financial sectors

- Facilitate engagement with companies, SMEs, business associations, Chambers of Commerce and other private-sector actors on responsible business conduct and Human Rights Due Diligence;

- Coordinate and support capacity-building and awareness-raising activities targeting private-sector actors;

- Facilitate engagement with the Association of Banks of BiH, the Central Bank of BiH and commercial banks in activities related to the integration of Business and Human Rights considerations into financial-sector risk assessment and advisory practices;

- Facilitate dialogue and knowledge exchange between the private sector, financial institutions, public institutions, academia and other relevant stakeholders;

- Ensure the documentation of experiences, lessons learned and emerging good practices from engagement with businesses and financial-sector actors.

d) Gender equality, monitoring and knowledge management

- Ensure that gender equality and human rights considerations are appropriately reflected in the planning and implementation of relevant project activities;

- Support gender-responsive stakeholder engagement and contribute to ensuring that project activities address relevant barriers and risks affecting women, including women-led enterprises and women-dominated workforces;

- Support collection, consolidation and analysis of project monitoring data and information in line with the project Results Framework;

- Contribute to documenting results, lessons learned, and evidence generated through project implementation;

- Support knowledge management, communication and dissemination of project results and knowledge products;

jobs.title: Assistente de Projetos (2 vagas) (Home Based) - [Open to internal and external applicants]
jobs.description:
Tiered Approach

In line with the commitment to safeguard capacity and support personnel already in the Organization, a majority of UNDP UNCDF/UNV vacancies are advertised using a tiered application process whereby:

- Tier 0 : UNDP/UNCDF/UNV IP staff holding permanent (PA) and fixed-term (FTA) appointments, whose posts will be abolished, or contracts will be terminated or not renewed during 2026.

- Tier 1 : Other UNDP/UNCDF/UNV staff holding permanent (PA) and fixed-term (FTA) appointments

- Tier 2 : UNDP/UNCDF/UNV staff holding temporary appointments (TA), personnel on regular PSA contracts, and Expert and Specialist UN Volunteers

- Tier 3 or no tier indicated : All other contract types from UNDP/UNCDF/UNV and other agencies, and other external candidates

Please make note of the Tier(s) indicated in the vacancy title, if any, and ensure that you satisfy the eligibility to apply.

Objetivo do Cargo e Contexto Organizacional

O Projeto Justiça 4.0 constitui uma das principais iniciativas de transformação digital do Poder Judiciário brasileiro e uma referência internacional em inovação e modernização dos serviços de Justiça. Iniciado em 2020, a partir de acordo de cooperação firmado entre o Conselho Nacional de Justiça (CNJ) e o Programa das Nações Unidas para o Desenvolvimento (PNUD/ONU), o Projeto tem como objetivo desenvolver, aprimorar e disseminar soluções tecnológicas que contribuam para tornar os serviços oferecidos pela Justiça brasileira mais eficientes, eficazes, acessíveis e centrados nas necessidades da população. A iniciativa também busca otimizar a gestão e a prestação jurisdicional, beneficiando magistrados(as), servidores(as), advogados(as) e demais atores do sistema de Justiça. O Projeto está alinhado aos Objetivos de Desenvolvimento Sustentável (ODS) e aos compromissos da Agenda 2030 das Nações Unidas.

Nesse contexto, as pessoas selecionadas atuarão como Assistentes de Projetos, prestando suporte técnico e operacional à implementação de projetos do PJ4.0. Serão selecionadas duas pessoas com atuação remota (home based).

Deveres e responsabilidades

O(a) Assistente de Projetos será responsável por prestar apoio administrativo, operacional e logístico à implementação e monitoramento das ações do Programa Justiça 4.0. O(a) profissional desempenhará atividades essenciais para garantir a conformidade processual, a eficiência dos fluxos administrativos e a correta aplicação das normas operacionais das iniciativas. Para o alcance desse objetivo, o(a) profissional desempenhará as seguintes responsabilidades principais e atividades:

1. Apoio à gestão de pessoas, onboarding e elaboração de (TR):

- Auxiliar na elaboração, revisão formal e tramitação de Termos de Referência (TR) para a seleção de pessoas físicas e jurídicas vinculadas às necessidades do programa;

- Apoiar operacionalmente as etapas de onboarding, integração e desligamento de profissionais vinculados(as) ao Programa Justiça 4.0;

- Apoiar a instrução documental de processos de recrutamento e seleção, bem como o controle de prazos de vigência, cronogramas de renovação e reajustes dos contratos da equipe.

2. Gestão, organização e tramitação eletrônica de processos e documentos:

- Acompanhar, organizar e instruir processos administrativos e comunicações oficiais por meio do Sistema Eletrônico de Informações (SEI) e demais canais institucionais utilizados pelas partes parceiras;

- Realizar lançamentos, registros e transações operacionais nos sistemas corporativos do PNUD, incluindo o Quantum, em conformidade com as orientações das áreas responsáveis;

- Organizar e manter atualizados arquivos digitais e pastas dos projetos, garantindo a padronização, a rastreabilidade, a segurança da informação e o fácil acesso à documentação.

3. Acompanhamento operacional e inserção de dados em plataformas de cooperação internacional:

- Apoiar o monitoramento de projetos de cooperação técnica internacional mediante o preenchimento, atualização e acompanhamento de dados das iniciativas no Sistema de Gestão de Convênios e Parcerias (SIGAP) da Agência Brasileira de Cooperação do Ministério das Relações Exteriores (ABC/MRE);

- Monitorar e apoiar o controle de prazos, cronogramas, metas e entregas dos projetos, identificando desvios e apoiando a articulação interna para a regularização de pendências;

- Auxiliar na compilação de informações para subsidiar o acompanhamento e as atualizações periódicas dos planos de trabalho e cronogramas gerais do programa.

4. Apoio à execução financeira, orçamentária e prestação de contas do PRODOC:

- Prestar suporte na coleta, organização e consolidação de dados orçamentários e financeiros para apoiar a elaboração de relatórios de progresso e prestações de contas periódicas do Documento de Projeto PRODOC;

- Apoiar o acompanhamento e consolidação de informações sobre a execução orçamentária, auxiliando na instrução de revisões orçamentárias e financeiras em conformidade com as normas do PNUD;

- Identificar inconsistências ou pendências financeiras e processuais, auxiliando na compilação de informações para auditorias e avaliações do projeto.

5. Apoio técnico a reuniões, instâncias de governança e documentação:

- Realizar o agendamento, envio de convites e apoio logístico geral para reuniões, oficinas, encontros tripartites e comissões técnicas das iniciativas;

- Elaborar documentos de suporte para reuniões, tais como pautas, memórias de reunião, atas oficiais, listas de presença, resumos executivos e relatórios de encaminhamentos;

- Acompanhar a execução das deliberações e recomendações acordadas nas reuniões e auditorias, monitorando os prazos de cumprimento junto aos(às) responsáveis.

6. Suporte logístico de viagens, diárias e providências operacionais:

- Apoiar a organização logística de viagens nacionais e internacionais dos projetos, incluindo cotações de passagens, reserva de hospedagens e cadastro de viajantes nos sistemas corporativos;

- Instruir, acompanhar e organizar os processos de concessão de diárias e passagens para consultores(as), parceiros(as) e equipes técnicas;

- Apoiar os fluxos de prestação de contas de diárias e passagens recebidas, realizando a conferência preliminar de relatórios de viagem, bilhetes de embarque e documentos fiscais comprobatórios.

7. Apoiar a construção e o compartilhamento de conhecimento relevantes para o projeto:

- Participar de treinamentos sobre procedimentos internos voltados à equipe do projeto e oferecer suporte à organização de capacitações e outras atividades de desenvolvimento de competências, conforme necessário.

- Contribuir de forma consistente para redes de conhecimento e comunidades de prática.

- Manter registros organizados de dados do projeto, atividades de campo, estudos de caso, relatos de experiências humanas, fotografias e outros documentos pertinentes que possam subsidiar o compartilhamento de conhecimento e ações de defesa de causas (advocacy).

O(a) titular desempenha outras funções dentro do seu perfil funcional que considere necessárias ao bom funcionamento do Projeto.

Arranjo Institucional

O(a) contratado(a) será supervisionado(a) pelo/a Especialista de Projetos em Justiça para o Desenvolvimento de projetos do PNUD.

Competências

- Alcançar Resultados - NÍVEL 1: Planeja e monitora seu próprio trabalho, presta atenção aos detalhes e entrega um trabalho de qualidade dentro do prazo.

- Pensar de forma Inovadora - NÍVEL 1: Aberto a ideias criativas e riscos conhecidos, é um solucionador de problemas prático e faz melhorias.

- Aprender Continuamente - NÍVEL 1: Mente aberta e curioso, compartilha conhecimento, aprende com os erros e pede feedback.

- Adaptar com Agilidade - NÍVEL 1: Adapta-se às mudanças, lida de forma construtiva com ambiguidades e incertezas, e é flexível.

- Agir com Determinação - NÍVEL 1: Demonstra determinação e motivação, mantém a calma diante da adversidade e tem confiança.

- Engajar e fazer Parcerias - NÍVEL 1: Demonstra compaixão e compreensão em relação aos outros, formando relacionamentos positivos.

- Promover a Diversidade e Inclusão - NÍVEL 1: Valoriza e respeita as diferenças, está consciente de vieses inconscientes e enfrenta a discriminação

Competências multifuncionais e técnicas

Direção e Estratégia de Negócios | Pensamento Estratégico

- Desenvolver estratégias eficazes e planos prioritários alinhados com a missão e os objetivos do PNUD, baseando-se em uma análise sistêmica de desafios, oportunidades e riscos potenciais; conectar a visão geral à realidade no campo para criar soluções tangíveis e direcionadas; aprender a partir de diversas fontes para antecipar e responder de forma eficaz às tendências atuais e futuras; demonstrar capacidade de previsão.

Direção de negócios e estratégia | Perspicácia Empresarial

- Capacidade de compreender e lidar com situações de negócios de forma a alcançar bons resultados. Habilidade para tomar boas decisões e fazer julgamentos rápidos dentro de tais contextos. Conhecimento e compreensão dos marcos operacionais da organização.

Desenvolvimento de negócios | Comunicação

- Comunicar de forma clara, concisa e inequívoca, tanto por meio da comunicação escrita quanto verbal; adaptar mensagens e escolher métodos de comunicação dependendo do público. Capacidade de gerenciar comunicações internas e externas, por meio da mídia, redes sociais e outros canais apropriados.

Gestão de negócios | Gestão de projetos

- Capacidade de planejar, organizar, priorizar e controlar recursos, procedimentos e protocolos para atingir objetivos específicos.

Dados | Análise de dados

- Capacidade de extrair, analisar e visualizar dados para gerar insights significativos e apoiar a tomada de decisões empresariais eficazes.

Agenda 2030: Paz | Estado de Direito, Segurança e Direitos Humanos

- Instituições Eficazes do Setor de Justiça

Agenda 2030: Paz | Estado de Direito, Segurança e Direitos Humanos

- Acesso à Justiça

- Diploma do Ensino Médio completo é requerido.

- Diploma universitário (Ensino Superior) nas áreas de Administração, Relações Internacionais, Comunicação, Ciências Sociais, Ciências Humanas, Gestão de Políticas Públicas, Contabilidade, Direito, Secretariado Executivo ou áreas afins será dada a devida consideração, mas não é um requisito.

Anos mínimos de experiência profissional relevante:

Habilidades desejadas, além das competências abordadas na seção Competências:

- Experiência profissional em apoio à gestão de projetos, incluindo planejamento, acompanhamento de cronogramas, monitoramento de atividades e elaboração de instrumentos de controle e controle documental;
